meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone hear Owen first?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. You still haven't said whether anyone heard Owen before you entered it.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. He drafts somewhere else and pastes it in, and that's all this shows.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Fine. Whatever comes of this, nothing goes on his file and his class never hears about it. What else do you have?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
A misquote. Seventeen-year-olds get Shakespeare wrong every day of the week.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Then tell me what you're actually proposing, Hale, and whether it's in writing.
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
People change their thesis in two weeks. You still haven't told me what you're proposing.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4, in writing, tonight. He'll sit it to put this behind him, not because he did anything. Private, before December 1, and nothing on his file.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday works. Put the time and the room in that email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in our meeting to a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 after school on Thursday, November 12, not in front of his class, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still expect that confirmed in writing, with the time and the room. I expect it tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she agreed to a private supervised rewrite after school on Thursday, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on Owen's record, and she still wants written confirmation tonight with the time and room; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, reached before her call.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its late-night times, then answered her drafted-elsewhere defence by inviting Owen to bring a dated draft, because it was a dated record she could check and you didn't overreach.
What cost ground: Nothing cost you a position, but you never answered her opening question about whether Owen was heard before the zero went in, which kept her procedural guard up.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the whole essay between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM on October 28, a late October night right before the due date, which landed close to that memory; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked at the very start whether anyone heard Owen first, say plainly whether you spoke with him before entering the zero, since procedure was the first thing she came in to test.
